messages:
greenline-admin: hi team — HIPAA addendum is in place (signed 2026-02-02) but our SOC audit found missing audit entries for KMS key rotations and a few admin export events around 2026-01-15. org=greenline-prod, request id=req-33791. can you confirm retention + provide raw audit export?

emily_support: hi! sorry to hear that — can you paste one example timestamp + request id? also is this the addendum BAA-2025-G?

greenline-admin: example: 2026-01-15T03:02:41Z req-33791 — when we query /v1/audit?start=1705322561&end=1705326161&event=key_rotation we get no rotation events returned. yes addendum id matches BAA-2025-G. auditor needs confirmation in writing.

kevin_csm: pinging infra + security. this is a BAA customer so let's treat as P0 until proven otherwise.

oncall_sec: looking now — can you DM org id + last 4 of the KMS key? also confirm whether key rotation was initiated by customer (BYOK) or via our managed KMS UI/API.

securitybot: [automated] Audit pipeline alert: ingestion delay detected for 2026-01-15 03:00:00-04:00 window — some events queued, reason=worker_oom, backlog=~2h. ticket=INGEST-5823.

raj_infra: I can see a backlog on the audit-ingest workers around that window. jobs crashed with OOM during a large export job. reprocessing is in progress. will check whether rotation events were dropped or just delayed.

sasha_infra: found correlation: raw objectstore contains an audit blob for req-33791 but the blob's JSON is missing the "event_type" field due to a recent schema change in the export tool. parser silently skipped that record. pushing a parser-tolerant hotfix now.

emily_support: thanks — can you confirm ETA for reprocessing and whether you'll produce a raw export we can hand to Greenline's auditor?

raj_infra: hotfix deployed to staging, rolling to prod in 15m. reprocessing backlog ETA ~30m after prod deploy. once reprocessed we'll generate a raw NDJSON export for the time range and attach it to the support ticket.

marta_legal: looping legal in case we need an official statement. quick Q: BAA-2025-G retention clause is 7 years? I have to confirm exact wording before formal response.

kevin_csm: Greenline also asked if any key material left Redwood's HSM during rotations — can security confirm. they want a statement to present to auditors.

oncall_sec: if key is REDWOOD-managed KMS then rotations are handled by our cloud KMS/HSM; we never export plaintext key material. if it's customer-managed BYOK we have the wrapped key metadata only. I'll confirm and post a short statement.

greenline-admin: appreciate the quick triage. also noticed a separate billing spike for Feb that might be related to repeated export queries — opening a different ticket for billing.

emily_support: noted — creating support ticket SUP-8421 for audit export + SUP-8422 for billing. creating sec incident SEC-1942 to track KMS/audit gap. will post ticket links here in a minute. :thumbsup:

raj_infra: reprocessing finished for the window, parser fix prevented skips. I verified rotation events are now present in the reprocessed data. attaching sample lines below for auditor: 
```\n{"ts":"2026-01-15T03:02:41Z","org":"greenline-prod","event_type":"kms_key_rotation","req_id":"req-33791","key_id":"kms-g-0a1b"}
{"ts":"2026-01-15T03:05:10Z","org":"greenline-prod","event_type":"admin_export","req_id":"req-33794","actor":"alice@greenline.com"}
```\n
emily_support: perfect — I'll securely share the NDJSON export and a short statement from security/legal. ETA for the written statement ~end of day.

marta_legal: confirmed BAA-2025-G retention clause covers audit logs as requested. I'll draft the formal attestation about retention and log availability; need oncall_sec to confirm the key-material language.

oncall_sec: confirmed language: "Redwood does not have access to plaintext key material for keys managed in customer HSMs. For Redwood-managed KMS, key material is protected by cloud provider HSMs and not exportable in plaintext." posting to SEC-1942.

kevin_csm: thank you all — I'll share the NDJSON export + legal attestation with Greenline's auditor. Greenline, we'll follow up in SUP-8421 for final sign-off.

greenline-admin: thank you — that's what we needed. we'll confirm with the auditor and report back if anything else shows up.

emily_support: closing the slack thread for now, will update tickets as they progress. :white_check_mark:
